svg.title: Monte Carlo | regime_v2 | 256 paths
svg.desc: OHLCV chart of 240 candles in UTC. Rising candles have a hollow body; falling candles have a filled body. Volume uses the same direction colors. Static exports show only visible overlays. Fuzzy Technologies.

g.text: Candles and volume: ensemble path 0. Lines or points: close quantiles across all paths.
P05-P95 is a pointwise synthetic range. Simultaneous path coverage has not been estimated.
